slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Gen 12:7: Then the LORD appeared to Abram and said, ‘I will give this land to your offspring.’
slides.body: “Then the LORD appeared to Abram and said, ‘I will give this land to your offspring.’”
slides.heading: Gen 12:7

slides.alt_text: Slide 2: Does one “offspring” mean Jesus? God promises land to Abraham’s “offspring.” Paul later points out that the word is singular and says it refers to Christ.
slides.body: God promises land to Abraham’s “offspring.” Paul later points out that the word is singular and says it refers to Christ.
slides.heading: Does one “offspring” mean Jesus?

slides.alt_text: Slide 3: Why Christians connect them Paul reads all God’s promises to Abraham as reaching their goal in one person: Jesus. People who belong to Jesus then become part of Abraham’s family too.
slides.body: Paul reads all God’s promises to Abraham as reaching their goal in one person: Jesus. People who belong to Jesus then become part of Abraham’s family too.
slides.heading: Why Christians connect them

slides.alt_text: Slide 4: But the word includes many people Genesis compares this same “offspring” to countless dust and stars. The word is singular but normally describes a whole family. Its grammar alone does not identify Jesus.
slides.body: Genesis compares this same “offspring” to countless dust and stars. The word is singular but normally describes a whole family. Its grammar alone does not identify Jesus.
slides.heading: But the word includes many people
